article.title: Common mistake: 'discuss about' vs 'discuss'
article.description: Wrong: 'Let's discuss about the plan.' Right: 'Let's discuss the plan.' Teaching point: 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about' — adding 'about' after it is redundant, though very common among learners.
article.content: Wrong: 'Let's discuss about the plan.' Right: 'Let's discuss the plan.' Teaching point: 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about' — adding 'about' after it is redundant, though very common among learners.

generated.caption:
Ever caught yourself saying 'discuss about'? Good news: you can make it simpler! The verb 'discuss' already means 'talk about', so you don't need 'about' after it. It's a common, easy fix!

👉 For example: 'Let's discuss the plan.'

generated.script: Aapne bhi kabhi 'discuss about' bola hai? Ye common mistake hum sab karte hain, right? Toh suno, bahut log bolte hain 'Let's discuss about the plan'. But ye galat hai. Actually, 'discuss' ka matlab hi hota hai 'talk about', yaani 'kisi cheez ke baare mein baat karna'. Toh 'about' uske saath lagana is completely redundant. Sahi tareeka hai 'Let's discuss the plan'. Ab samajh aaya? Next time, simply use 'discuss', no 'about' needed. Comment mein batao, kya aapko ye mistake pata thi? Aur aise hi quick English tips ke liye follow The English Vault!

slides.body: It's a common mistake, but the word 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about'. Adding 'about' after it makes it redundant, even though many learners mistakenly do so. You don't 'discuss about' something; you simply 'discuss' it directly. For example, instead of 'Let's discuss about the plan,' the correct phrase is 'Let's discuss the plan.' Remember, 'discuss' already includes the idea of 'about' within its meaning.
slides.hindiSummary: 'Discuss' शब्द का अर्थ ही 'किसी विषय पर बात करना' होता है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'about' लगाना अनावश्यक है।
